messages:
Ivy (Support): Customer BK-711 reports a disputed charge for $199.00 with bank ref DB-9001. They say it9s a duplicate subscription charge.

Ivy (Support): invoice INV-2026-05-02-211, charge: ch_1Mdup9001. Customer provided a screenshot showing two identical charges 5 minutes apart.

Sam (Risk): pulling logs. same card fingerprint appears on two accounts created via the same IP and user-agent. looks like a double-submit race during our subscription activation path.

billing-bot: webhook: charge.succeeded ch_1Mdup9001 at 2026-05-02T08:12:10Z

Jesse (Finance): we need evidence packet: invoice PDF, API provisioning trace, payment intent timestamps, and any support chat. If duplicate due to our retry, refund and submit dispute evidence ASAP.

Maya (BillingOps): putting account on billing hold, creating evidence packet EP-2026-05-02-44. Attaching allocator and signup logs that show two subscription creates: tx=a1 -> sub_s1, tx=a2 -> sub_s2. Recommend refunding later charge ch_1Mdup9001.

Ivy (Support): informed customer we9re investigating and offered immediate refund. they prefer refund now.

Jesse (Finance): approved. Maya, issue refund and mark invoice INV-2026-05-02-211 as refunded. include internal memo: "duplicate subscription created due to retry race during activation; see alloc traces".

billing-bot: refund issued rf_1Mref9001 (pending)

Maya (BillingOps): refund succeeded rf_1Mref9001, evidence packet submitted to Stripe dispute_response for DB-9001. closing for now; will monitor for chargeback posting.

Ivy (Support): customer confirmed refund. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
